output.interpretation: "Liver cancer" is too broad to turn into a single two-group comparison yet. The most likely reading is primary liver tumour tissue (case) compared with adjacent non-tumour or normal liver (control), but the subtype, model system and comparison all still need to be chosen.

clarifying_questions.question: Which type of liver cancer do you mean?
clarifying_questions.why: The subtype decides which series qualify. HCC has the most paired tumour/non-tumour tissue series: six checked here (GSE124535, GSE144269, GSE169289, GSE202853, GSE176271, GSE184733), plus GSE33294 and GSE146719, which were found but not checked. For iCCA, I checked GSE119336 (15 pairs); GSE63420 was found but not checked. For hepatoblastoma, I checked GSE81928 (pediatric); GSE199888 was found but not checked. For fibrolamellar carcinoma, GSE63018 and GSE181922 were found but not checked. For the combined subtype, GSE241466 and GSE179443 were found but not checked.

clarifying_questions.question: What should the two groups be?
options: Tumour vs adjacent non-tumour / normal liver tissue
Tumour subgroup vs subgroup (e.g. recurrent vs primary, responders vs non-responders to treatment, cause of disease such as HBV or fatty liver disease)
Liver cancer cell line: gene knockdown/knockout vs control
Liver cancer cell line: drug-treated or drug-resistant vs parental
clarifying_questions.why: Patient tissue series answer the tumour vs normal question. The roughly 900 RNA-seq hits mostly test a single gene or drug in HepG2, Huh7, Hep3B or other cell lines, and those only make sense if you name the gene or drug.

clarifying_questions.question: Do you have a preference for patient population (adult vs pediatric, or ethnicity/etiology)?
clarifying_questions.why: Hepatoblastoma series are pediatric. HCC tissue cohorts differ by population and cause: Chinese (GSE124535, early stage), Mongolian (GSE144269), Hispanic (GSE202853), African American/European American (GSE176271) and Caucasian (GSE184733). That matters if more than 10 series qualify.
